fields.summary: Qualify fleet coverage and budgets before collecting configurations
Collect distinct constructible configurations with resumable batches
Enrich resolved fleet configurations with matching facts and images
Collect and validate 10,000 genuinely distinct BMW configurations
Publish the configuration corpus and generate stock by order reference
Prove full-corpus lookup and offline recovery through the port

comments.body:
F58–63 delivery handoff — 7 November 2026

FUCQ-58 is verified In Review. Development is ready for review; acceptance and Done remain open.

Configuration-only qualification is merged and independently reviewed; 17 focused checks passed, including 14 legacy cases. The sealed selection covers exactly 10,000 configurations with digest-pinned context, coverage and explicit unknowns. Evidence: https://github.com/garyscarter-ibm/vehicle-matcher/blob/7c10dd90074e5c8c48698dae59c0e6329c7022f4/docs/gcsp/evidence/fucq-58/configuration-only-qualification-2026-11-07/

Scope correction superseding the earlier overnight gate assessment: the agreed Q13 identity contract uses configurationId for corpus records and order reference plus configuration for stock. VIN/profile/five-WMI requirements apply to delivered/current cars; there is no 10,000-VIN or 10,000-stock gate. FUCQ-77 owns every-scheme-model demo coverage. No new source collection is authorized by qualification.

F58–63 delivery handoff — 7 November 2026

FUCQ-59 is verified In Review. Development is ready for review; acceptance and Done remain open.

Collector implementation is merged and independently reviewed. Exactly 10,000 configurations were selected from 10,351 admitted configurations. Evidence and the six-criterion assessment: https://github.com/garyscarter-ibm/vehicle-matcher/blob/7c10dd90074e5c8c48698dae59c0e6329c7022f4/docs/gcsp/evidence/fucq59/completion-assessment-2026-11-07/

Original AC4 remains partial: public continuation refetches three still-valid safe bootstrap projections (10 actual GETs, zero cache hits in the retained proof). This independently deferred Medium defect is distinct from FUCQ-152; it is being reconciled to a linked backlog Bug, without making it a build/merge dependency. No repair or AC waiver is claimed. Historical full-suite failures/skips remain recorded.

F58–63 delivery handoff — 7 November 2026

FUCQ-60 is verified In Review. Development is ready for review; acceptance and Done remain open.

The current-code integration processed and reconciled all 10,000 selected configurations: 10,000 explicit partial outcomes, zero rejected results and zero outbound calls. The same-current-collector-session bridge and final reconciliation passed; independent five-AC review recommends In Review. Evidence: https://github.com/garyscarter-ibm/vehicle-matcher/blob/7c10dd90074e5c8c48698dae59c0e6329c7022f4/docs/gcsp/evidence/fucq60/implementation-readiness-2026-11-07/

The declared two image associations and unknown technical/image facts remain explicit. This retained replay does not assert that the original live source collection executed enrichment. The historical suite remains 1,848 passed / 19 failed / five skipped; deferred defects remain unresolved.

F58–63 delivery handoff — 7 November 2026

FUCQ-61 is verified In Review. Development is ready for review; acceptance and Done remain open.

The numerical target is delivered: 10,351 genuinely distinct admitted configurations, exactly 10,000 selected and staged. Semantic/staging verification and cached replay passed. The 32-allocation accounting reconciliation records 19,978 GETs and 13,744 solver operations. Evidence: https://github.com/garyscarter-ibm/vehicle-matcher/blob/7c10dd90074e5c8c48698dae59c0e6329c7022f4/docs/gcsp/evidence/fucq61/accounting-reconciliation-2026-11-07/

Acceptance must retain one irrecoverable interrupted outcome, incomplete whole-history traffic/comparable-duration observations and the original allocation RAM overrun. These limits are documented; no unobserved aggregate is claimed. The explicit 6 November request superseded the earlier post-demo scheduling hold for this sequence.

F58–63 delivery handoff — 7 November 2026

FUCQ-62 is verified In Review. Development is ready for review; acceptance and Done remain open.

Release fleet-2026-11-07-12 is published: 31 checksum-pinned assets, 574,382,841 bytes, 10,000 selected source configurations plus one retained reference/current-car VIN. Scoped Linux build 42361586991 passed cold restore, offline repeat, exact assets and five-reference boundaries. Replacement Render deployment 7620961777 (dep-dbnhane8bjmc73a7v5qg), code c87b6f075c4e79bee93b71e1965ad23310ab8473, succeeded at 12:28:04 UTC.

Actual live run 42372746118 passed at 12:30:19 UTC: health, readiness and configuration each returned HTTP 200, with exact .12 manifest and first DTO hashes. Evidence: https://github.com/garyscarter-ibm/vehicle-matcher/blob/7c10dd90074e5c8c48698dae59c0e6329c7022f4/docs/gcsp/evidence/fucq62/fleet-dot12-linux-live-run42372746118/

Earlier failed/time-limited runs remain failed evidence. Known consumer and image-fixture defects are independently deferred. Stock generator ownership remains FUCQ-78; no claim of managed Render stock persistence is added.

F58–63 delivery handoff — 7 November 2026

FUCQ-63 is verified In Review. Development is ready for review; acceptance and Done remain open.

Final native PostgreSQL run 42372886620 passed on 7 November at 12:35:46 UTC, exact integration 8c76c96341701dd3fbfa1ddb6ead207cff323b4a. Three exact current-run orders passed direct, configured-consumer and loopback HTTP checks after repository close/reopen; nativeProof:true, checked:3, currentRunUnchanged:true, and zero source/egress/errors. The separately published inventory snapshot was retained at run version 3. Evidence: https://github.com/garyscarter-ibm/vehicle-matcher/blob/7c10dd90074e5c8c48698dae59c0e6329c7022f4/docs/gcsp/evidence/fucq63/linux-postgres-corrected-result-2026-11-07/

The full retained .12 lookup proof matched 10,002 direct/local-HTTP references. Prior failed native runs remain immutable; the setup correction used the existing repository transaction/CAS and unchanged prover assertions. All 2,707 known configuration-consumer failures remain deferred/unfixed. This three-order CI sample does not prove full consumer replay, all-stock enumeration or managed Render stock persistence.

Remote cleanup passed: schema, service and scratch absent; 925,223,392 bytes removed.

defectsReconciliation: in progress independently; no Story build dependency
